name: lemonsqueezy
description: 65 shared tasks for current Lemon Squeezy commerce, private main/license credentials, approved effects, reviewed batches and bounded exports.
long_description: 60 reviewed native operations plus five local helpers through shared CLI/local MCP. Main-key test/live verification is separate from license mode and store ownership. All21effects require confirmation; no retries or automatic continuation. Signed outputs stay in new private files. Official SDK and community strengths remain credited.

api_key.title: Private main API key
api_key.description: Private main Bearer API key in the intended test/live mode. Choose this OR token_file. Keep outside repositories.

token_file.title: Private API key file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private regular non-symlink file outside repositories. Choose instead of api_key; restrict Windows ACLs.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse all21native/local effects, including private exports.

mode.title: Main API key mode
mode.description: test or live; defaulttest. Checked with native users/me. Does not prove license mode or store ownership.

license_key.title: Private independent license key
license_key.description: Purchased license key for native License API only; choose this OR license_file. Main API credentials are separate.

license_file.title: Private license-only file
license_file.description: Absolute owner-private regular non-symlink license-only file outside repositories; choose instead of license_key. Restrict Windows ACLs.
